Aviation Monorepo - Available targets:
Build & Test:
  make build         - Build all applications and packages
  make clean         - Clean all build artifacts and dependencies
  make test          - Run Node, Go, shared Python SDK, and Flight Track Analyzer suites
  make test-python   - Run other Python suites when their environments are available
  make test-clojure  - Run the Clojure suite when Leiningen is available
  make test-docker   - Run all tests in Docker containers (recommended)
Run Applications (build + start):
  make run-aviation-missions    - Run Aviation Missions App (port 8080)
  make run-flight-planner       - Run Flight Planner (ports 8000+5173)
  make run-flight-school        - Run Flight School demo (port 5001)
  make run-foreflight-dashboard - Run ForeFlight Dashboard (port 5051)
  make run-flight-tracker       - Run Flight Tracker (port 3001)
  make run-weather-briefing     - Run Weather Briefing (port 3002)
  make run-g1000-simulator      - Run G1000 Simulator (backend + frontend)
  make run-flight-track-analyzer - Run Flight Track Analyzer (port 8010)
  make stop-all                 - Stop all running applications
  make deploy-check             - Validate all twelve deployment definitions
  make deploy-build APP=name    - Build a committed app image for do-host1
  make deploy-dns APP=name      - Register its DNS name (DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN_FILE required)
  make deploy-app APP=name      - Build and install its systemd/Caddy service
  make deploy-verify APP=name   - Check the running revision, public UI, and isolated E2E
Component targets:
  make build-node          - Build Node.js/TypeScript applications
  make build-python        - Build Python applications
  make build-clojure       - Build Clojure applications
  make clean-node          - Clean Node.js artifacts
  make clean-python        - Clean Python artifacts
  make clean-clojure       - Clean Clojure artifacts
  make test-node           - Test Node.js applications locally
  make test-python         - Test Python applications locally
  make test-clojure        - Test Clojure applications locally
  make test-docker-node    - Test Node.js apps in Docker
  make test-docker-python  - Test Python apps in Docker
  make test-docker-clojure - Test Clojure apps in Docker
  make audit               - Run security audits (Node.js + Python)
  make release             - Run release workflow (tests, changelog, tag, push, GitHub release)
